text: An active open problem in HoTT as of 2024 is:
choices: whether the suspension of the 2-sphere S³ is equivalent to ΩS⁴
a fully human-readable, computer-checkable proof of Brunerie's π₄(S³)=ℤ/2ℤ that is not just a normalisation proof
whether univalence is consistent with MLTT
explanation: While the Cubical Agda normalisation verified π₄(S³)=ℤ/2ℤ computationally, a conceptual, mathematically illuminating proof (as opposed to just machine normalisation) remains an open challenge.
